_help.people: Display names. The ledger stores who = me / partner; the dashboard and Hermes use these names.
_help.partner_merchant_prefixes: Ledger rows with an empty `who` whose merchant starts with one of these count as the partner's (e.g. ["Astro"]).
_help.private_names: Extra names (kids, friends) hidden as Person 1, 2… when the app is opened with ?demo=1 (for screenshots you share).
